kind.description: bug_analysis when a cause was investigated, needs_info when the issue lacks the information to start, not_a_bug when the behaviour is intended

confidence.description: Confidence in the cause stated in headline

headline.description: Shown first. The cause in at most two short sentences, plain words, no more than 300 characters. For needs_info: what is missing, in one sentence.

fix_summary.description: Shown first. The recommended fix in one or two sentences, no more than 250 characters. Empty string when there is no fix to suggest.

uncertainty.description: Shown first. The most important thing you could not verify, in one sentence, no more than 200 characters.

explanation.description: Shown in the collapsed details. How the problem happens, step by step, in at most 6 short sentences.

evidence.description: At most 3 items, strongest first. The first item is shown as the location of the problem.

quote.description: Verbatim text from those lines, at most 3 lines

why.description: What this code shows, in one sentence

ref.description: Issue or pull request number such as #12, or a commit SHA of at least 7 characters

open_questions.description: For needs_info, the questions for the reporter, most important first
